stubs.service: Browser-side persisted cart (redux-persist over localStorage) for a returning shopper
stubs.how: src/components/storage/index.tsx wraps the localStorage adapter when built with NEXT_PUBLIC_UI_CAPTURE_SEED=1 (set in .env.production.local): if no 'persist:root' exists yet, it loads /ui-capture-seed/persist-root.json, generated by .ui-capture/seed/seed-cart.mjs replaying addToCart/removeCartItem/remove actions through the app's own cartsSlice reducer. Once the user edits the cart, the real localStorage value takes over.

notes: Shopco is a front-end-only Next.js 14 (App Router) storefront with no backend, auth or third-party calls; fonts and images are local. Setup: node 20.20.2 via mise (mise.toml), npm install, `npm run build` (production build is already in .next/), and .ui-capture/start.sh runs `next start` on $PORT (4423). Server mode, not static export, because /shop/product/[...slug] is rendered dynamically. Data: the product catalog (12 products: New Arrivals, Top Selling, You might also like), customer reviews, brands and dress styles are the repo's own demo data in src/app/page.tsx; it was left as-is because it lives in UI code and only 15 product images ship with the repo. User state is the cart: it is seeded with 8 line items / 10 units (tees, jeans, polo, striped shirt in two sizes, Bermuda shorts x2, with mixed sizes/colours and discounts; subtotal $1736, $1496 after discounts), so the navbar cart badge shows 10 and /cart shows a full order summary. Re-run `node .ui-capture/seed/seed-cart.mjs` to regenerate the seed (no rebuild needed; it is served from public/). To reset in the browser, clear localStorage key 'persist:root'. Main areas: / (home: hero, brands, New Arrivals, Top Selling, Browse by Dress Style, customer reviews carousel), /shop (catalog grid with filters sidebar, sort, pagination), /shop/product/<id>/<slug> (gallery, colour/size pickers, add to cart, Product Details/Rating & Reviews/FAQs tabs, related products), /cart (cart items with quantity controls, order summary, promo code).
